interventions.description: Installing curb extensions at intersections or mid-block would shorten crossing distances and improve visibility by moving pedestrians past the line of parked cars.

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Cushions
interventions.description: Adding vertical deflection would help maintain low vehicle speeds appropriate for a residential neighborhood.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: If space permits, introduce a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility marked crosswalks to designate safe crossing locations.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone to provide a physical buffer between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair cracked concrete slabs and remove vegetation to ensure a smooth, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Implement a furniture zone or planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.
